# WOFF2 reader fixtures — provenance

Generated by `scripts/build-font-fixtures.py` (block typeface plan, Task 1) with fontTools 4.60.2 and
brotli 1.2.0 (pip). Re-running rewrites every file; output bytes depend on both versions.

Source fonts: the default theme's Figtree (`packages/thallo-render/themes/default/assets/fonts/`,
SIL OFL 1.1 — `OFL.txt` here; upstream https://github.com/erikdkennedy/figtree v2.0.3). The fixtures
are modified versions (re-saved, instanced, truncated) used only as test data.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `variable.woff2` | Figtree roman, variable `wght` 300–900, re-saved as WOFF2 |
| `variable-italic.woff2` | Figtree italic, variable `wght` 300–900 |
| `static-700.woff2` | roman instanced at `wght` 700 (static) |
| `static-400-italic.woff2` | italic instanced at `wght` 400 (static) |
| `truncated.woff2` | the first half of `variable.woff2` |
| `not-a-font.woff2` | an HTML snippet with a `.woff2` name |
| `wrong-flavour.woff` | Figtree roman as WOFF 1 |
| `bomb.woff2` | `variable.woff2`'s real header and table directory followed by a Brotli stream that inflates to 64 MiB |
| `brotli/<sample>.q{0,5,11}.br`, `<sample>.raw` | Brotli vectors: empty, `LICENSE` text, 4 KiB random, a 256 KiB repeat, `variable.woff2`'s real decompressed table stream (`font-tables`), and ~1 MiB of it (`big-tables`) |
| `brotli/expansion-64m.br` | the bomb's 64 MiB expansion stream on its own |

The differential corpus for the Brotli port is separate: `tests/fixtures/brotli/` (`scripts/build-brotli-vectors.py`).
